:::{#def-mode}
#### Mode of a density or mass function

Let $X$ be a [random variable](#def-random-variable)
with [density](#def-pdf) or [mass function](#def-pmf) $f$.
A **mode** of $f$ is an element of the [argmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra.html#def-argmax) of $f$ over the [range](#def-range) of $X$.
The [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-set) of modes of $f$ is

$$\modef{f} = \argmax_{x \in \rangef{X}} f(x).$$

This is the [mode](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra.html#def-mode) of the [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function) $f$ on $\rangef{X}$.

:::
